# OptionList

Consolidated with ListGroup - uses ListGroup.Option subcomponent for flexible option list popups. Supports single-select (radio) or multi-select (checkbox) modes.

**Import:** `import { OptionList } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/OptionList.jsx`
